Compact but Mighty.

Smart Power in a Durable, Operator-Friendly Package.

The 2024 KIOTI CK3520MB is a versatile compact tractor designed to handle a variety of jobs around the farm, home, or job site. With a 35 HP diesel engine and mechanical shuttle transmission, this model delivers dependable performance for everything from mowing and loader work to hauling and land maintenance. Its compact size allows for easy maneuvering while still delivering the muscle you need.

A perfect fit for small property owners, landscapers, and anyone seeking a no-nonsense, high-value tractor.

Features may include:

Reliable 35 HP Diesel Engine
KIOTI 3-cylinder engine offers fuel efficiency, quiet operation, and solid performance.

8×8 Mechanical Shuttle Transmission
Smooth gear transitions with a clutchless forward/reverse shuttle ideal for loader work.

3-Point Hitch Power
Category I hitch with 1,631 lbs lift capacity handles standard implements with ease.

Independent PTO
540 RPM PTO with simple lever engagement makes powering attachments a breeze.

Open Operator Platform
ROPS design with wide, semi-flat deck and conveniently placed controls for comfort and safety.

Hydraulic Versatility
11.3 GPM total flow with dual remotes to support hydraulic implements and loader use.

Standard Power Steering & 4WD
Standard features ensure easy handling and excellent traction across all terrain.
